reason: A named lab and a batch report I can match to the number on the box is exactly what I look for, and it is rare on TikTok Shop. At $24.99 with a money-back guarantee I will try one box, mostly because a sachet I can't forget on the counter suits me.
objection: Brand new, no real customer reviews yet, and it is made in China. I would open the lab report and check that it is a real lab and a real batch, not a pretty PDF.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report turned out to be generic, not tied to the batch number, or the lab could not be found, I would not buy.
